## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 4, 2026 - Sep 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _cameronstarrenergy_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a paid user for years but recently the app shows that I am not a paid user with ads popping up. When I go to upgrade it says I am already a subscriber. I have had to delete the app and restart it in order for it to work again but it doesn’t last. Please fix this."
            2. _TerriJo_, Sep 6, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve subscribed to MyFitnessPal Premium intermittently for years, and I’ve always come back because the core tracking tools are solid. But this time has been incredibly frustrating.I purchased MFP Premium in February 2026 and the subscription still shows as active in my Apple Subscriptions list. Despite that, the app refuses to recognize it — Premium features are locked, Restore Purchase is missing, and Manage Subscription doesn’t appear anywhere.I contacted MyFitnessPal support about this problem back in May, provided screenshots, and followed every step they suggested. Months later, nothing has been resolved. Apple says the issue is with the app, and the app says nothing helpful at all.After years of being a paying customer, it’s disappointing to hit a subscription entitlement failure that neither Apple nor MFP seems willing or able to fix. I hope the developers take this seriously, because long‑time users shouldn’t have to fight this hard just to access a subscription they already paid for."
            3. _ghrtman_, Sep 5, 2026, 3/5: "First, it does a nice job in free mode of recording and displaying my data. But, it is too expensive for me to buy and then every two weeks it logs me out and deletes my data. I’m aggravated that they don’t have a free mode and treat my data as a tool to force me into buying. Will not purchase this app and deleting it from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->
